text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article whose primary focus is on predicting biodiversity loss and species extinctions due to hydropower-driven deforestation, not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction itself. Although it uses projected forest loss from dam construction as input (e.g., estimating hectares of forest submerged or degraded under two scenarios), LULC change is not the central research objective but rather a supporting step for ecological impact assessment. The study does not implement spatially explicit LULC modeling with accuracy metrics, nor does it produce mapped LULC projections as primary outputs. Furthermore, the analysis is regional (Indian Himalaya), not national-scale across all of India, failing the explicit national-scale spatial implementation criterion. It also lacks quantitative spatial modeling of LULC dynamics beyond aggregated area estimates derived from external data.)
